contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman nummus (perhaps a contemporary copy) of Constantine I (AD 306-37), VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC P reverse type depicting two Victories standing, holding wreath inscribed VO / P R; altar between them. Dating to AD 318-20 (Reece period 16). Mint uncertain, perhaps Trier. Die axis 9
